manifest.name: fallback-test-on-t_0cb8edbd
manifest.purpose: Fallback test ordered by the operator on 15.11.2026 (card t_0cb8edbd; doc/setup/plan-engine-claude.md, Einrichten step 7): a volatile drop-in under /run/systemd/system sets COCKPIT_CLAUDE_EXECUTABLE=/nonexistent for the agent and the runner unit, so every Claude role must fall back to opencode/DeepSeek and mark NOTBETRIEB. Nothing under /etc changes, no secret is read or written. A transient timer removes the drop-ins and restarts both units after 40 minutes at the latest; a follow-up run removes them earlier. A reboot also removes them (/run). If any runtime drop-in sits on the agent or runner unit or any fallback revert timer is armed (whatever card placed it), the run stops before changing anything: it never renews or extends a running test.

steps.name: place volatile drop-ins and the self-revert timer
steps.run:
set +e +u; set +o pipefail 2>/dev/null || true
if systemctl show -p DropInPaths --value wireguard-ops-cockpit-agent.service wireguard-ops-cockpit-runner.service | tr ' ' '\n' | grep -q '^/run/' || [ -n "$(systemctl list-timers --all --no-legend 'cockpit-rueckfalltest-revert-*' 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo 'a runtime drop-in or a fallback revert timer is in place: not renewed, nothing changed'; exit 1; fi
mkdir -p /run/systemd/system/wireguard-ops-cockpit-agent.service.d
printf '[Service]\nEnvironment=COCKPIT_CLAUDE_EXECUTABLE=/nonexistent\n' > /run/systemd/system/wireguard-ops-cockpit-agent.service.d/50-rueckfalltest-t_0cb8edbd.conf
mkdir -p /run/systemd/system/wireguard-ops-cockpit-runner.service.d
printf '[Service]\nEnvironment=COCKPIT_CLAUDE_EXECUTABLE=/nonexistent\n' > /run/systemd/system/wireguard-ops-cockpit-runner.service.d/50-rueckfalltest-t_0cb8edbd.conf
systemctl daemon-reload
systemd-run --unit=cockpit-rueckfalltest-revert-t_0cb8edbd --on-active=40min /bin/sh -c 'rm -f /run/systemd/system/wireguard-ops-cockpit-agent.service.d/50-rueckfalltest-t_0cb8edbd.conf; rmdir /run/systemd/system/wireguard-ops-cockpit-agent.service.d 2>/dev/null || true; rm -f /run/systemd/system/wireguard-ops-cockpit-runner.service.d/50-rueckfalltest-t_0cb8edbd.conf; rmdir /run/systemd/system/wireguard-ops-cockpit-runner.service.d 2>/dev/null || true; systemctl daemon-reload; systemctl restart wireguard-ops-cockpit-agent.service wireguard-ops-cockpit-runner.service; '
systemctl list-timers cockpit-rueckfalltest-revert-t_0cb8edbd.timer --no-pager | head -n 3

steps.name: restart agent and runner units
steps.run:
set +e +u; set +o pipefail 2>/dev/null || true
systemctl restart wireguard-ops-cockpit-agent.service wireguard-ops-cockpit-runner.service
sleep 5
systemctl is-active wireguard-ops-cockpit-agent.service wireguard-ops-cockpit-runner.service

checks.name: drop-ins in place and units active
checks.run:
set -eu
grep -qx 'Environment=COCKPIT_CLAUDE_EXECUTABLE=/nonexistent' /run/systemd/system/wireguard-ops-cockpit-agent.service.d/50-rueckfalltest-t_0cb8edbd.conf
systemctl is-active wireguard-ops-cockpit-agent.service
grep -qx 'Environment=COCKPIT_CLAUDE_EXECUTABLE=/nonexistent' /run/systemd/system/wireguard-ops-cockpit-runner.service.d/50-rueckfalltest-t_0cb8edbd.conf
systemctl is-active wireguard-ops-cockpit-runner.service

checks.name: self-revert timer armed
checks.run:
set -eu
systemctl is-active cockpit-rueckfalltest-revert-t_0cb8edbd.timer

rollback: Remove /run/systemd/system/<agent|runner unit>.d/50-rueckfalltest-t_0cb8edbd.conf, systemctl daemon-reload, restart both units; the timer cockpit-rueckfalltest-revert-t_0cb8edbd does exactly this after 40 minutes.

Nothing under /etc changes, no secret is read or written. A transient timer removes the drop-ins and restarts both units after 40 minutes at the latest; a follow-up run removes them earlier. steps.run:
set +e +u; set +o pipefail 2>/dev/null || true
if systemctl show -p DropInPaths --value wireguard-ops-cockpit-agent.service wireguard-ops-cockpit-runner.service | tr ' ' '\n' | grep -q '^/run/' || [ -n "$(systemctl list-timers --all --no-legend 'cockpit-rueckfalltest-revert-*' 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo 'a runtime drop-in or a fallback revert timer is in place: not renewed, nothing changed'; exit 1; fi

systemd-run --unit=cockpit-rueckfalltest-revert-t_0cb8edbd --on-active=40min /bin/sh -c 'rm -f /run/systemd/system/wireguard-ops-cockpit-agent.service.d/50-rueckfalltest-t_0cb8edbd.conf; rmdir /run/systemd/system/wireguard-ops-cockpit-agent.service.d 2>/dev/null || true; rm -f /run/systemd/system/wireguard-ops-cockpit-runner.service.d/50-rueckfalltest-t_0cb8edbd.conf; rmdir /run/systemd/system/wireguard-ops-cockpit-runner.service.d 2>/dev/null || true; systemctl daemon-reload; systemctl restart wireguard-ops-cockpit-agent.service wireguard-ops-cockpit-runner.service; '
systemctl list-timers cockpit-rueckfalltest-revert-t_0cb8edbd.timer --no-pager | head -n 3

steps.name: restart agent and runner units
